anomalies_surfaced: ANOMALY-1 (MATERIAL, plan-fixture/model defect — NOT a code or safety defect): INVENTORY IS NOT A PROSE-RESULT DOMAIN. The real get-results stock render is a NUMBERED multi-row list (e.g. SRTWT902 -> 9 numbered lines). compile-current-state's _resultsNumbered detector (>=2 leading-numbered lines) therefore FIRES on inventory partial-miss turns, so the marker carries [results numbered] and a bare number routes to AMBIGUOUS->CLARIFY, not DYM. Plan/UAC §PD-dym repeatedly call inventory 'PROSE' and expect bare-number->dym there — empirically false. Consequences: (a) §PD-dym as literally specified is UNREACHABLE on inventory; the quick bare-number dym-pick affordance the redesign envisioned for inventory does NOT exist — inventory users must type 'suggestion N' or answer the clarify. (b) bare-number->dym (prose) is reachable ONLY for single-row (<=1 numbered line) results. The code behaves correctly; the plan's domain taxonomy needs reconciliation. Recommend planner/user decide whether the numbered inventory render is intended (then §PD-dym should target a genuine single-row/prose result) or whether inventory should be de-numbered for this affordance.

ANOMALY-2 (fixture bug): the plan/task literal T1 string 'SRTW808 @3 SRTW809 @2 SRTWT902 @5 check stock' is degenerate — the parser reads '@3 @2 @5' as reference_positions [3,2,5] and dead-ends to a general-search gate. Used clean phrasing 'check stock for SRTWT902, SRTW808 and SRTW809' (SRTWT902 resolves; SRTW808->[SRTWT808,SRTWT1808,SRTWT4808], SRTW809->[SRTWT809,SRTWT1809,SRTWT4809]).

ROBUSTNESS FINDING (positive): output_exchange's dym_last_result_set-presence gate contains ALL observed classifier imperfection. On no-dym (§PD-noref-R) and full-miss (§PD-fullmiss) turns the parser sometimes emits a non-null reference_target ('ambiguous'/'dym'), but the handler early-returns when dym_last_result_set is absent, so positions flow to the unchanged byIdx and behaviour is byte-identical to today. This gate is the backbone of backward-compat and it held under every misfire.

R4 REPLAY-NORM NUANCE (for reviewer): reference_target is NOT reliably null on no-dym turns (observed 'ambiguous' on a no-dym bare number). The planned LESSON-40 'ignore-when-null-both-sides' norm() rule will therefore NOT fully suppress it — no-dym golden turns where the classifier emits non-null will DIFF (behaviorally inert). Reviewer should decide: always-ignore reference_target, or ignore-unless-a-dym-set-is-present, rather than ignore-when-null.
